recognize_zh: 原發腫瘤切片為一致的小圓細胞實性片狀生長；骨髓抹片中出現成群、細胞質淡藍、核圓且染色質呈顆粒狀（鹽與胡椒樣）的非造血細胞，易被誤認為芽細胞或漿細胞，免疫細胞化學在細胞質呈陽性並帶樹突狀突起——符合轉移性甲狀腺髓質癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheets of monotonous small round-to-spindled tumor cells with a fibrous capsule and adjacent fat
Panels B–C (smear): clusters of medium-to-large non-hematopoietic cells with round, often eccentric nuclei
Coarsely granular 'salt-and-pepper' chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm, some with fine pink granules; loose cohesion
Panels D–E (immunocytochemistry): strong cytoplasmic brown staining with dendritic cytoplasmic processes (marker not labeled; likely calcitonin/neuroendocrine marker)
describe_en: Panel A shows a solid, cellular neoplasm composed of monotonous small cells in sheets with a fibrous capsule. Bone marrow aspirate smears (B, C) contain clusters of medium-to-large, loosely cohesive non-hematopoietic cells with round eccentric nuclei, finely granular neuroendocrine-type chromatin and pale cytoplasm, some with fine pink granules; at low power these cells mimic plasma cells or blasts. Immunocytochemistry on the smear (D, E) shows strong cytoplasmic staining with dendritic processes. In a patient with a thyroid primary, the findings are consistent with bone marrow metastasis of medullary thyroid carcinoma; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells show clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD138/light chain-restricted rather than calcitonin/chromogranin-positive.
Blasts are non-cohesive with fine open chromatin and nucleoli, and are CD45/CD34-positive and keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma or neuroblastoma
ddx.vs: Share neuroendocrine markers, but show nuclear molding and scant cytoplasm (small cell) or rosettes in children (neuroblastoma), and lack calcitonin/CEA expression.
Lobular carcinoma cells form single files, are GATA3/ER-positive, E-cadherin-negative and neuroendocrine marker-negative.
